detailZones.title: Dialysis chair and monitor
detailZones.description: Inspect the unoccupied dialysis chair, bedside monitor, blood-pressure cuff, table and visible chair hardware.

detailZones.title: Dialysis delivery console
detailZones.description: Explore the blank console screen, control panel, pump modules, doors, lower cabinet and mobile base.

detailZones.title: Dialyzer and bloodline circuit
detailZones.description: Follow the transparent dialyzer housing, end caps, tubing loop, clamp and colored connectors.

detailZones.title: Dialysis wall box and connections
detailZones.description: Inspect the recessed wall box, its frame, colored connector hoses and the nearby wall dispenser.

detailZones.title: Utility cart and disinfection area
detailZones.description: Explore the supply cart, drawers, waste containers, utility sink, counter and cabinet.

detailZones.title: Room support and background stations
detailZones.description: Look through the glass partition to the background chair, machine, curtains and supply cabinet.

anchorAudit.rationale: The published image shows separate points for the chair cushions and foot pedal, three pump windows, the dialyzer end caps and the blue, yellow and red wall-box hoses. 44 original terms remain in the index because their objects or functions cannot be distinguished. The index also contains 30 terms for a kidney care visit, including conditions, staff and generic medicines.
